evidence.excerpt: In an exploratory intervention on $400$ Omni-MATH problems with gemma-4, keeping the role prompts but forcing submission in every cycle raises recovery from $0.198$ to $0.613$; the paired comparison detects no difference from the role-free team.

evidence.excerpt: Removing roles largely eliminates functional specialization without lowering first-pass accuracy.

evidence.excerpt: In an exploratory comparison with feedback available to both teams, the role-free team recovers more often across all five model--benchmark settings.
